relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of the TRPs leads to CGRP release, which can act on its receptors on the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels, resulting in strong vasodilation [70,71].

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Experimental data has shown that CGRP can sensitize nociceptors and also can induce central sensitization [65].

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Eptinezumab, fremanezumab, and galcanezumab selectively bind to the CGRP itself as a ligand, while erenumab competitively and reversibly targets CGRP receptor components.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: This was the first clinical observation that clearly demonstrated that CGRP can induce migraine attacks, leading to the development of small molecule CGRP receptor antagonists, gepants.

key_findings: Scoping review: migraine and neuropathic pain share CGRP, TRP channels, endocannabinoid, kynurenine, cytokine and microglial mechanisms.
Anti-CGRP mAbs improved Neuropathic Pain Scale scores in CM patients with NP; 8% capsaicin patch (TRPV1) effective in peripheral NP.
